message.content: ChaeSong-hwa shares an article with LiHua about how human beings form short-term and long-term memories. According to the conversation, LiHua found the article particularly intriguing and shocking, highlighting the complexity and intricacy of the human brain in processing and storing memories. The article likely delves into the mechanisms by which our brains encode, retain, and recall different types of memories, influenced by factors such as emotions and context.
